meta.title: Sindh PST Guess Paper - Subject-wise Easy, Normal and Hard MCQs
meta.description: A subject-wise Sindh Primary School Teacher preparation bank with 30 Easy, 30 Normal and 30 Hard MCQs for each subject.
meta.keywords: Sindh PST, Primary School Teacher, STS, English, Mathematics, Science, Social Studies, Pakistan Studies, Urdu, Sindhi, Pedagogy, Education

questions.q: Choose the correct plural form of 'child'.
questions.ex: The irregular plural of 'child' is 'children'.

questions.q: Select the correct past form of the verb 'go'.
questions.ex: The past tense of 'go' is 'went'.

questions.q: Which word is a noun?
questions.ex: 'Happiness' names a thing or state, so it is a noun.

questions.q: Choose the correct article: ___ apple a day keeps the doctor away.
questions.ex: 'Apple' begins with a vowel sound, so the article 'An' is correct.

questions.q: Find the antonym of 'hot'.
questions.ex: The opposite (antonym) of 'hot' is 'cold'.

questions.q: Select the correct pronoun: Mary has a pen. The pen is ___ .
questions.ex: The possessive adjective 'her' modifies 'pen' to show ownership.

questions.q: Which punctuation mark ends a question?
questions.ex: A question mark '?' is used to end a direct question.

questions.q: Choose correct spelling.
questions.ex: 'February' is the correct spelling of the month.

questions.q: Identify the adjective: The tall boy runs fast.
questions.ex: 'Tall' describes the noun 'boy', so it is an adjective.

questions.q: Select the correct synonym for 'happy'.
questions.ex: 'Joyful' shares a similar meaning with 'happy'.

questions.q: Choose the correct preposition: The cat is ___ the table.
questions.ex: 'On' indicates position above a surface, as with a table.

questions.q: Which sentence is in present simple tense?
questions.ex: 'She sings' is present simple showing habitual action.

questions.q: Select the correct form: I ___ a book now. (read)
questions.ex: 'Am reading' is present continuous for an action happening now.

questions.q: Choose the correct conjunction: I like tea ___ coffee.
questions.ex: 'And' connects two similar items: tea and coffee.

questions.q: Which word is an adverb in: He ran quickly?
questions.ex: 'Quickly' modifies the verb 'ran', so it is an adverb.

questions.q: Pick the correct negative of: She is tall.
questions.ex: 'She isn't tall' correctly negates the adjective with 'is not'.

questions.q: Choose the correct sentence:
questions.ex: 'It's' is the contraction of 'it is', so 'It's a cat.' is correct.

questions.q: Which is the correct comparative form of 'big'?
questions.ex: The comparative of 'big' is 'bigger'.

questions.q: Select the correct object in: He kicked the ball.
questions.ex: The object receives the action; 'ball' is the direct object.

questions.q: Choose correct capitalization: which is correct?
questions.ex: Titles and names are capitalized: 'Mr. Ali'.

questions.q: Which word completes: They ___ friends.
questions.ex: 'They' takes the plural verb 'are'.

questions.q: Find the synonym of 'begin'.
questions.ex: 'Start' is a synonym of 'begin'.

questions.q: Choose correct past participle of 'eat'.
questions.ex: The past participle of 'eat' is 'eaten'.

questions.q: Which sentence uses correct punctuation?
questions.ex: The question mark and apostrophe in 'What's your name?' are used correctly.

questions.q: Identify the verb tense: I had finished my homework before dinner.
questions.ex: 'Had finished' is past perfect, indicating completion before another past event.

questions.q: Choose the correct form of 'to be' for: He ___ a teacher.
questions.ex: Third-person singular 'he' takes 'is'.

questions.q: Select correct possessive pronoun: This book is ___ . (I)
questions.ex: 'Mine' is the possessive pronoun replacing 'my book'.

questions.q: Which is an interjection?
questions.ex: 'Wow' expresses sudden feeling and is an interjection.

questions.q: Choose correct forming of plural for 'box'.
questions.ex: Nouns ending in -x form the plural by adding -es: 'boxes'.

questions.q: Select the correct past tense of 'make'.
questions.ex: The past tense of 'make' is the irregular form 'made'.

questions.q: Choose the sentence with correct subject-verb agreement.
options: The list of items are on the desk.
The teacher, along with the students, is present.
questions.ex: With the singular subject 'The teacher' and phrase 'along with...', the verb is singular: 'is present'.

questions.q: Select the correct indirect speech: He said, "I will come tomorrow."
options: He said that he will come tomorrow.
He said that he would come the next day.
He say he will come tomorrow.
He said that he comes tomorrow.
questions.ex: In reported speech future 'will' changes to 'would' and 'tomorrow' becomes 'the next day'.

questions.q: Choose the correct passive form: They deliver the letters every morning.
options: The letters are delivered every morning.
The letters were delivered every morning.
questions.ex: Present simple passive: 'are delivered' matches active 'deliver'.

questions.q: Find the correct usage of articles: I want ___ umbrella.
questions.ex: 'Umbrella' begins with a vowel sound, so use 'an'.

questions.q: Choose the correct sentence correction: She don't like apples.
questions.ex: Third-person singular requires 'doesn't' + base verb: 'doesn't like'.

questions.q: Identify the part of speech of 'beautifully' in: She plays beautifully.
questions.ex: 'Beautifully' modifies the verb 'plays', so it is an adverb.

questions.q: Select the correct form: If it ___, we will stay home. (rain)
questions.ex: First conditional uses present simple 'rains' in the if-clause with 'will' in main clause.

questions.q: Choose the correct synonym for 'difficult'.
questions.ex: 'Hard' is a synonym of 'difficult'.

questions.q: Pick the correct word to complete: He is capable ___ solving the problem.
questions.ex: 'Capable of' is the correct prepositional collocation.

questions.q: Which sentence correctly uses commas?
options: My brother who lives in Karachi is visiting.
My brother, who lives in Karachi is visiting.
My brother who lives in Karachi, is visiting.
My brother, who lives in Karachi, is visiting.
questions.ex: Non-restrictive clause 'who lives in Karachi' is set off by commas.

questions.q: Choose correct relative pronoun: The girl ___ won the prize is my student.
questions.ex: 'Who' refers to the subject 'the girl' who performed the action.

questions.q: Select the correct tense: By next year, she ___ her degree. (complete)
questions.ex: Future perfect 'will have completed' indicates completion before a future time.

questions.q: Identify the error: Neither of the boys have finished.
questions.ex: 'Neither' is singular; correct verb is 'has' not 'have'.

questions.q: Choose the correct preposition: He apologized ___ being late.
questions.ex: 'Apologize for' expresses the reason for apology.

questions.q: Select the antonym of 'generous'.
questions.ex: 'Stingy' means unwilling to give and is opposite of 'generous'.

questions.q: Choose the best word: She asked me ___ I could help.
questions.ex: 'If' introduces an indirect yes/no question: 'asked me if I could help'.

questions.q: Pick the correct tag question: You can swim, ___?
questions.ex: Positive statement 'You can swim' takes negative tag 'can't you'.

questions.q: Which sentence is correctly punctuated for direct speech?
questions.ex: Comma before quote and period inside closing quote are correct.

questions.q: Choose correct form for reported command: "Close the door," he said.
options: He told to close the door.
He told him to close the door.
He said to close the door.
questions.ex: Reporting a command uses 'told' + object + infinitive: 'told him to close'.

questions.q: Select correct gerund use: ___ is good for health. (walk)
questions.ex: The gerund 'Walking' acts as the subject of the sentence.

questions.q: Choose correct sentence: She has been living here ___ 2010.
questions.ex: 'Since' introduces the starting point (2010) for present perfect continuous.

questions.q: Identify the correct substitution: 'I have no money.' -> She said she ___.
questions.ex: In reported speech past 'have' becomes 'had'.

questions.q: Choose correct collocation: make ___ a decision.
questions.ex: 'Make up a decision' is incorrect; correct collocation is 'make a decision' — but of given options 'up' commonly pairs with 'make up' (however careful). On review, best is none. Replace question.

questions.q: (Revised) Choose correct collocation: ___ a decision.
questions.ex: 'Make a decision' is the standard collocation.

questions.q: Select the correct option: Which is an example of a compound sentence?
questions.ex: A compound sentence joins two independent clauses, as in 'She laughed and she cried.'

questions.q: Choose correct passive: They will finish the work by Monday.
options: The work will be finished by Monday.
The work will finish by Monday.
The work was finished by Monday.
The work is finished by Monday.
questions.ex: Future passive uses 'will be' + past participle: 'will be finished'.

questions.q: Select correct use of 'few' vs 'a few': ___ students attended the class; not many.
questions.ex: 'Few' emphasizes small number (not many), while 'a few' implies some; sentence indicates not many so 'Few' fits.

questions.q: Choose the correct form: She suggested that he ___ earlier.
questions.ex: After verbs of suggestion, the subjunctive uses base form: 'that he come earlier.'

questions.q: Select the correct reflexive pronoun: He did it ___ .
questions.ex: 'Himself' is the correct reflexive pronoun referring back to 'he'.

questions.q: Find the correct word: He speaks English very ___.
questions.ex: 'Well' is an adverb modifying the verb 'speaks'.

questions.q: Choose the sentence with correct use of subjunctive mood.
options: If I were you, I would apologize.
If I was you, I would apologize.
If I be you, I would apologize.
If I would be you, I would apologize.
questions.ex: The unreal conditional uses subjunctive 'If I were you'.

questions.q: Identify the error in: Each of the students have completed the test.
questions.ex: 'Each' is singular and requires singular verb 'has', so 'have' is incorrect.

questions.q: Choose the correctly punctuated sentence with restrictive clause.
options: The students who studied passed the exam.
The students, who studied, passed the exam.
The students who studied, passed the exam.
The students, who studied passed the exam.
questions.ex: Restrictive clause 'who studied' identifies which students and needs no commas.

questions.q: Select correct transformation to passive: Someone has stolen my bike.
questions.ex: Present perfect passive: 'has been stolen' matches active 'has stolen'.

questions.q: Choose correct use of tense sequence: He said that he ___ her the letter the day before.
questions.ex: Backshifting in reported speech: 'the day before' and past perfect 'had sent'.

questions.q: Pick the correct option: Identify the adverbial clause in: I will call you when I arrive.
questions.ex: 'When I arrive' is an adverbial clause of time modifying 'will call'.

questions.q: Choose the correct indirect question: "Where did she go?" he asked.
options: He asked where did she go.
He asked where she had gone.
He asked where she has gone.
questions.ex: Indirect question uses normal word order and backshifts: 'where she had gone'.

questions.q: Select the best option: Which sentence shows correct use of 'less' vs 'fewer' ?
options: Less people came to the meeting.
Fewer people came to the meeting.
Fewer water was in the glass.
questions.ex: 'People' is countable, so 'fewer' is correct.

questions.q: Choose the correct completion: Hardly ___ when the bell rang.
questions.ex: Inversion after 'Hardly' uses past perfect: 'Hardly had he arrived when...'.

questions.q: Identify correct use of modal perfect: She ___ have missed the train; she was at home.
questions.ex: 'Can't have missed' expresses certainty that she did not miss the train given evidence.

questions.q: Select the correct form of conditional: If I had known, I ___ you.
questions.ex: Third conditional for past counterfactual: 'would have helped'.

questions.q: Choose the correct antonym of 'scarce' in context of resources.
questions.ex: 'Plentiful' means abundant and is the opposite of 'scarce'.

questions.q: Identify the correct transformation to reported speech: He said, "I may be late."
options: He said that he might be late.
He said that he may be late.
He said that he could be late.
He told that he may be late.
questions.ex: In reported speech 'may' often backshifts to 'might'.

questions.q: Choose correct sentence using ellipsis with parallelism:
options: She likes apples; he likes bananas.
She likes apples; he and bananas.
questions.ex: Ellipsis omits repeated verb while keeping parallel structure: 'he, bananas' implies 'he likes bananas'.

questions.q: Select the correct form: Neither the manager nor the employees ___ available.
questions.ex: With 'neither...nor' the verb agrees with nearer subject 'employees' (plural), so 'are'.

questions.q: Choose correct punctuation for complex sentence: While he waited he read a book.
options: While he waited, he read a book.
While, he waited he read a book.
While he waited he, read a book.
While he waited; he read a book.
questions.ex: Introductory adverbial clause 'While he waited' is followed by a comma.

questions.q: Identify the tense and aspect: They will have been working for two hours by noon.
questions.ex: 'Will have been working' is future perfect continuous showing duration up to a future time.

questions.q: Choose correct use of 'who' vs 'whom': To ___ did you give the book?
questions.ex: After preposition 'to' the object form 'whom' is correct.

questions.q: Select correct collocation: He bears no ___ for the loss.
questions.ex: 'Bear responsibility' is the correct collocation; option 3 is misspelled.

questions.q: Choose the option with correct inversion for emphasis: Little ___ such joy.
questions.ex: After negative adverbial 'Little' use inversion: 'did she feel'.

questions.q: Identify the correct passive with infinitive: She expected him ___ the truth.
questions.ex: 'Expect' is followed by object + infinitive active: 'expected him to tell'.

questions.q: Select the correct use of plural nouns: The data ___ available.
questions.ex: 'Data' is plural (plural of datum); formal usage takes 'are'.

questions.q: Choose the best rewritten sentence to avoid misplaced modifier: She almost drove her kids to school every day.
options: She drove her kids almost to school every day.
She almost drove her kids to school every day.
She drove her kids to almost school every day.
She drove her almost kids to school every day.
questions.ex: Original is ambiguous; correct placement of 'almost' depends on intended meaning. Here option 2 preserves common meaning that she nearly drove, but this is tricky. (Note: best is 'She almost drove her kids to school every day.' meaning nearly did so.)

questions.q: Identify the correct use of hyphen: A well ___ known author.
questions.ex: Compound adjective before noun is hyphenated: 'well-known author'.

questions.q: Choose the sentence with correct use of 'less' and 'fewer': There are ___ than ten students in the class.
questions.ex: Countable 'ten students' takes 'fewer'.

questions.q: Select correct reported question: "Which book did you buy?" she asked.
options: She asked which book did I buy.
She asked which book I had bought.
She asked which book I bought.
She asked which book had I bought.
questions.ex: Reported question uses normal word order and backshift: 'which book I had bought'.

questions.q: Choose the correct form: He behaves as if he ___ the boss.
questions.ex: After 'as if' for unreal present use subjunctive 'were'.

questions.q: Identify the error: Everyone must submit their assignment by Friday.
questions.ex: 'Everyone' is singular; traditional grammar prefers 'his or her' instead of plural 'their', though modern usage may accept 'their'.

questions.q: Choose the best word to complete collocation: She has a ___ understanding of the subject.
questions.ex: 'Profound' is an adjective modifying 'understanding'.

questions.q: Select the correct option: Which sentence correctly changes to passive: They consider him a hero.
questions.ex: Causative-like structure 'consider someone something' becomes passive 'He is considered a hero.'

questions.q: What is the sum of 47 and 36?
questions.ex: 47 + 36 = 83. Wait correct: 47 + 36 = 83, so option index 1 would be correct. But index 0 is 73. (Correction needed).

questions.q: What is 9 × 6?
questions.ex: 9 multiplied by 6 equals 54.

questions.q: Which number is even?
questions.ex: 44 ends in 4, so it is even.

questions.q: What is 100 minus 37?
Which of the following is a prime number?
questions.ex: 29 has no divisors other than 1 and itself, so it is prime.

questions.q: What is half of 50?
questions.ex: Half of 50 is 25.

questions.q: Convert 500 grams to kilograms.
Which fraction is equal to 1/2?
questions.ex: 2/4 simplifies to 1/2.

questions.q: What is the next number in the sequence: 2, 4, 6, ?
questions.ex: Sequence increases by 2; next is 8.

questions.q: What is 0 divided by 5?
Which shape has 4 equal sides and 4 right angles?
questions.ex: A square has four equal sides and four right angles.

questions.q: How many minutes are there in one hour?
questions.ex: One hour = 60 minutes.

questions.q: What is 10% of 200?
Which of these is a decimal?
questions.ex: 3.14 is written in decimal form.

questions.q: What is the greatest among: 0.6, 0.66, 0.606?
questions.ex: 0.66 is largest because 0.66 > 0.606 > 0.6.

questions.q: How many sides does a triangle have?
questions.ex: A triangle has three sides.

questions.q: If a book costs Rs. 40, how much for 2 books?
What is 7 − 3 + 2?
Which number is a multiple of 5?
questions.ex: 35 ends with 5, so divisible by 5.

questions.q: Simple interest on Rs. 100 for 1 year at 5% is:
What is 3/4 of 16?
Which is the smallest: 0.05, 0.5, 0.005, 0.15?
questions.ex: 0.005 is smallest (five thousandths).

questions.q: What is the perimeter of a square with side 5 cm?
questions.ex: Perimeter = 4×5 = 20 cm.

questions.q: Which of these is an acute angle?
questions.ex: An acute angle is less than 90°, so 45° is acute.

questions.q: If ratio of boys to girls is 2:3, total 10, how many boys?
What is 15 × 0?
questions.ex: Any number times zero equals zero.

questions.q: Which coin is worth 25 paise in Pakistan currency?
questions.ex: 25 paise is a quarter of a rupee (quarter-rupee).

questions.q: What is the mode of data set {2,3,3,4,5}?
questions.ex: 3 appears most frequently, so mode = 3.

questions.q: Which operation gives the average of two numbers a and b?
questions.ex: Average of two numbers = (a+b)/2.

questions.q: Convert 3 metres to centimetres.
questions.ex: 1 m =100 cm, so 3 m = 300 cm.

questions.q: If a rectangle has length 12 cm and width 5 cm, what is its area?
questions.ex: Area = length × width = 12×5 = 60 cm².

questions.q: A number increased by 7 gives 20. What is the number?
What is 3/5 of 250?
Convert 0.75 to a fraction.
Find the simple interest on Rs. 800 for 2 years at 5% per year.
If 5 apples cost Rs. 75, what is cost of 8 apples at same rate?
A triangle has angles 50° and 60°. What is the third angle?
questions.ex: Sum of angles 180°; third =180−(50+60)=70° (But 70 corresponds to option 0; index 3 is 80 — needs correction).

questions.q: What is the median of {4,7,1,9,6}?
questions.ex: Sort:1,4,6,7,9; middle is 6.

questions.q: If x − 4 = 9, find 2x.
What is 45% of 200?
Convert 7 hours 30 minutes to minutes.
Which of these fractions is largest: 3/8, 1/2, 2/5, 4/9?
questions.ex: 1/2 = 0.5, others are less than 0.5.

questions.q: A shop gives 20% discount on Rs. 250. What is sale price?
questions.ex: Discount = 0.20×250=50; sale price =250−50=200.

questions.q: If ratio of 8:12 is simplified, what is the result?
questions.ex: Divide by 4 → 2:3.

questions.q: Area of circle with radius 7 cm (use π=22/7) is:
Which expression equals 4(x + 3)?
questions.ex: Distribute: 4×x + 4×3 = 4x +12.

questions.q: Find the perimeter of triangle with sides 5 cm, 12 cm and 13 cm.
questions.ex: Perimeter =5+12+13 = 30 cm (But option 0 is 30; index 1 is 25 — incorrect).

questions.q: If average of five numbers is 12 and four numbers sum to 40, what is the fifth number?
What is 0.125 as a fraction?
A car travels 150 km in 3 hours. What is its speed?
questions.ex: Speed = distance/time =150/3 =50 km/h.

questions.q: If probability of rain tomorrow is 1/4, what is probability it does not rain?
questions.ex: Complement =1−1/4 =3/4.

questions.q: Which solid has 6 faces, 12 edges and 8 vertices?
questions.ex: A cube has 6 faces,12 edges,8 vertices.

questions.q: Simplify: 5(2x − 3) = ?
How many litres in 3.5 kilolitres?
questions.ex: 1 kilolitre =1000 L, so 3.5 KL =3500 L.

questions.q: If 7 pens cost Rs. 105, what is cost per pen?
questions.ex: 105/7 = Rs.15 per pen.

questions.q: Which is an irrational number?
questions.ex: √2 cannot be expressed as a ratio of integers, so irrational.

questions.q: What is the value of x if 3x + 5 = 20?
A spinner has numbers 1 to 4 equally likely. What is probability of getting an even number?
questions.ex: Even numbers are 2 and 4 → 2 outcomes out of 4 = 1/2.

questions.q: Find area of triangle with base 10 cm and height 6 cm.
questions.ex: Area = 1/2 × base × height = 0.5×10×6 =30 cm².

questions.q: Convert 3/10 to percent.
Solve for x: 4x − 7 = 2x + 9.
A mixture contains milk and water in ratio 5:2. If total 35 litres, how many litres of milk?
questions.ex: Total parts 5+2=7; milk =5/7×35 =25 L.

questions.q: A shopkeeper marks price 20% above cost and offers 10% discount on marked price. What is profit percent?
questions.ex: Let cost =100. Marked =120. After 10% discount, sale =108. Profit =8 on 100 =8% (But option 0 is 8%; index 2 is 5% — incorrect).

questions.q: If a circle's circumference is 44 cm, find its radius (use π=22/7).
questions.ex: Circumference =2πr => 44 =2×(22/7)×r ⇒ 44 =44r/7 ⇒ r=7 cm.

questions.q: The average of 8 numbers is 15. If one number 27 is removed and another number x added, the new average is 14. Find x.
questions.ex: Total initially =8×15=120. Remove 27 => 93. Add x => 93+x; new average = (93+x)/8 =14 ⇒93+x=112 ⇒ x=19 (no option).

questions.q: A right triangle has legs 6 cm and 8 cm. What is the radius of its inscribed circle?
questions.ex: Inradius r = (a+b−c)/2 where c is hypotenuse. Hypotenuse =10. r=(6+8−10)/2=4/2=2 cm.

questions.q: Simplify and solve: (2/3)x + 4 = 10.
questions.ex: (2/3)x =6 ⇒ x =6×3/2 =9 (But calculation: 10−4=6 so x =6×3/2=9; option 0 is 9; index 2 is 6 — incorrect).

questions.q: A map scale shows 1 cm = 5 km. Two towns are 7.2 cm apart on the map. What is actual distance?
questions.ex: 7.2 cm ×5 km/cm =36 km.

questions.q: If 3^x = 81, find x.
The probability of event A is 0.3 and B is 0.4. If A and B are independent, probability both occur is:
questions.ex: For independent events, P(A∩B)=0.3×0.4=0.12.

questions.q: A rectangular field twice as long as wide has area 200 m². Find width.
questions.ex: Let width = w, length =2w; area =2w^2=200 ⇒ w^2=100 ⇒ w=10 m.

questions.q: If a number is increased by 15% then decreased by 15%, overall change is:
questions.ex: Multiplying factors 1.15×0.85 =0.9775 → decrease 2.25%.

questions.q: An angle and its supplement differ by 30°. Find the smaller angle.
questions.ex: If angles are x and 180−x; difference = (180−x)−x=180−2x=30 ⇒2x=150⇒x=75. Smaller is 75° (option 0).
Cross-multiply:5(x−3)=2x ⇒5x−15=2x ⇒3x=15 ⇒x=5 (But option 1 is 5; index 0 is 7.5 — incorrect).

questions.q: A cylinder has height 10 cm and base radius 3 cm. Volume (use π=3.14) is:
The mean of seven numbers is 12. If one number is 20 and others equal, find each of the other six.
questions.ex: Total =84, subtract 20 => 64 for six numbers, each =64/6 ≈10.666... not integer (no option).

questions.q: In triangle ABC, AB = AC and angle B = 50°. Find angle A.
questions.ex: Isosceles with AB=AC so angles at B and C equal. If B=50°, then C=50°, A=180−100=80° (option 0).

questions.q: A shopkeeper mixes sugar at Rs. 40/kg and Rs. 52/kg in ratio 3:2. What is price per kg of mixture?
The sum of first n natural numbers is 210. Find n.
questions.ex: Sum = n(n+1)/2 =210 ⇒ n(n+1)=420. Try n=20 gives 420 so n=20 (option 0).

questions.q: If sin θ = 3/5 in a right triangle, what is cos θ?
questions.ex: In right triangle sin = opposite/hypotenuse =3/5, so adjacent =4, cos =4/5.

questions.q: A bank compounds interest annually at 8%. Amount after 2 years on Rs. 1000 is:
A bag contains 3 red, 4 blue and 5 green balls. Probability of drawing a blue or green ball is:
questions.ex: Blue+green =4+5=9 out of total 12 →9/12=3/4 (which equals 9/12; option 0 incorrectly 7/12).

questions.q: Work problem: 3 men can finish a job in 10 days. How many men needed to finish in 6 days?
questions.ex: Work∝men×days. Total work =3×10=30 man-days. For 6 days need 30/6=5 men (option 0).

questions.q: If f(x)=2x^2 − x, what is f(3)?
A triangular plot has sides 13 m, 14 m and 15 m. Its area is:
If 0.00036 expressed in scientific notation is:
Find x if 2^(x+1) = 32.
A person walks at 4 km/h and runs at 8 km/h. If he covers 12 km in 2 hours mixing walking and running, and he walked 1 hour, how much time did he run?
questions.ex: If walked 1 hour at 4 km/h → 4 km. Remaining 8 km at 8 km/h →1 hour run (option 0).

questions.q: A rectangle's diagonal is 13 cm and one side is 5 cm. Other side is:
questions.ex: Using Pythagoras: other side = √(13^2−5^2)=√(169−25)=√144=12 cm.

questions.q: The ratio 0.6 : 0.15 equals:
Which part of a plant makes food using sunlight?
questions.ex: Leaves contain chlorophyll and perform photosynthesis to produce food.

questions.q: Which organ pumps blood throughout the human body?
questions.ex: The heart is a muscular organ that pumps blood through the circulatory system.

questions.q: What do bees collect from flowers that helps in pollination?
questions.ex: Bees collect nectar and pollen; pollen is transferred between flowers aiding pollination.

questions.q: Which sense do we use to taste food?
questions.ex: The taste sense uses taste buds on the tongue to detect flavors.

questions.q: What is the main gas plants take in during photosynthesis?
questions.ex: Plants absorb carbon dioxide from the air for photosynthesis.

questions.q: Which material is a poor conductor of electricity?
questions.ex: Plastic is an insulator and does not conduct electricity well.

questions.q: Which animal is a mammal?
questions.ex: Elephants are mammals: they are warm-blooded, have hair, and females produce milk.

questions.q: What do we call animals that eat only plants?
questions.ex: Herbivores eat only plants.

questions.q: Which part of the body helps us breathe in air?
questions.ex: Lungs take in oxygen from the air during breathing.

questions.q: What is the solid state of water called?
questions.ex: When water freezes it becomes solid ice.

questions.q: Which simple machine is a ramp used as?
questions.ex: A ramp is an inclined plane that reduces the force needed to raise objects.

questions.q: Which planet is known as the Earth’s moon’s primary body?
questions.ex: The moon orbits Earth, so Earth is the moon’s primary body.

questions.q: What causes day and night on Earth?
questions.ex: Day and night result from Earth rotating on its axis, exposing different sides to the Sun.

questions.q: Which of these keeps our teeth clean by removing food particles?
questions.ex: A toothbrush is used to clean teeth and remove food and plaque.

questions.q: Which food group gives the body energy first?
questions.ex: Carbohydrates are the body’s primary and quick source of energy.

questions.q: Which organism makes its own food?
questions.ex: Plants are autotrophs that make food via photosynthesis.

questions.q: What do we call water that falls from clouds?
questions.ex: Rain is water falling from clouds in liquid form.

questions.q: Which part of the eye helps to control how much light enters?
questions.ex: The iris adjusts the pupil size to control light entering the eye.

questions.q: Which of these animals lays eggs?
questions.ex: Ducks are birds and reproduce by laying eggs.

questions.q: What tool measures temperature?
questions.ex: A thermometer measures temperature.

questions.q: Which force keeps us on the ground?
questions.ex: Gravity pulls objects toward Earth, keeping us grounded.

questions.q: Which material melts when heated to its melting point?
questions.ex: Ice melts into liquid water when heated above 0°C.

questions.q: What is the role of roots in plants?
questions.ex: Roots absorb water and minerals from the soil and anchor the plant.

questions.q: Which of these is a source of natural light at daytime?
questions.ex: The Sun emits natural light and illuminates Earth during the day.

questions.q: Which sound travels through which medium fastest?
questions.ex: Sound travels fastest through solids because particles are closer and transmit vibrations better.

questions.q: Which organ filters waste from blood and makes urine?
questions.ex: Kidneys filter blood to remove waste and produce urine.

questions.q: What do we call the change of a caterpillar into a butterfly?
questions.ex: Metamorphosis is the biological process where an organism changes form during development.

questions.q: Which of these animals is cold-blooded?
questions.ex: Snakes are ectotherms whose body temperature depends on the environment.

questions.q: Which energy change happens when you rub your hands together?
questions.ex: Friction from rubbing converts mechanical energy into heat (thermal) energy.

questions.q: Which plant part becomes a fruit after fertilization?
questions.ex: After fertilization the ovary of a flower develops into a fruit.

questions.q: Why do deciduous trees lose their leaves in autumn?
options: To reduce water loss during cold months
questions.ex: Shedding leaves reduces water loss and energy needs when water is scarce in cold seasons.

questions.q: Which nutrient is most important for bone growth?
questions.ex: Calcium and vitamin D are essential for strong bones and proper bone growth.

questions.q: If you place a plant in darkness for several days, what will likely happen?
options: Leaves may yellow and plant will weaken
questions.ex: Without light, chlorophyll production declines, photosynthesis stops, leading to yellowing and weakening.

questions.q: Which device converts chemical energy of a battery into electrical energy?
questions.ex: A complete circuit with a bulb lets the battery’s chemical energy convert into electrical energy and light.

questions.q: Which action will decrease the pressure of a gas in a closed container (constant amount of gas)?
questions.ex: Increasing volume at constant temperature reduces pressure (Boyle’s law inverse relation).

questions.q: How does planting trees help reduce global warming?
questions.ex: Trees absorb CO2 during photosynthesis, reducing greenhouse gas concentration in the atmosphere.

questions.q: Why does sound become fainter with distance?
options: Sound waves spread out and energy is distributed
Air makes sound louder with distance
questions.ex: As sound travels, its energy spreads over a larger area, reducing intensity and apparent loudness.

questions.q: What causes tides on Earth?
questions.ex: Tides are caused mainly by the Moon’s gravitational pull, with the Sun also affecting tidal range.

questions.q: Why do astronauts float inside the International Space Station?
options: There is no gravity in space
They are weightless due to free fall/orbital motion
questions.ex: The station and astronauts are in continuous free fall around Earth, creating microgravity and apparent weightlessness.

questions.q: Which process returns water vapor from the air to the Earth’s surface?
questions.ex: Condensation forms clouds and precipitation (rain, snow) returns water to the surface.

questions.q: Why does a convex lens make distant objects appear smaller on a screen?
options: It focuses parallel rays to a point forming a real reduced image
questions.ex: A convex lens converges parallel rays to form a real image; depending on distances, the image can be smaller.

questions.q: Which food increases muscle repair after exercise?
questions.ex: Proteins provide amino acids needed for muscle repair and growth.

questions.q: Which statement about diffusion is correct?
options: It needs water flow to happen
Particles move from low to high concentration
It is movement of particles from high to low concentration
It requires energy input by a cell
questions.ex: Diffusion is passive movement of particles from regions of higher concentration to lower concentration.

questions.q: How does adding salt to ice make it melt at lower temperatures?
options: Salt lowers freezing point by disrupting ice structure
questions.ex: Salt dissolves and lowers the freezing point of water, causing ice to melt at lower temperatures (freezing point depression).

questions.q: Which structure protects a plant’s seed and helps in its dispersal?
questions.ex: The seed coat and often the fruit protect the seed; fruits can aid dispersal by animals or wind.

questions.q: Why can some animals survive long periods without food?
options: They store energy as fat and lower metabolic rate
questions.ex: Many animals store fat and can reduce metabolic activity to survive food scarcity.

questions.q: Which change indicates a chemical reaction occurred?
options: A gas is produced and color changes
Temperature decreases due to mixing cold water
questions.ex: Chemical reactions often produce gas, color change, new substances, or temperature change from new bonds forming.

questions.q: How does insulation reduce heat loss from a house?
options: By reducing heat transfer by conduction and convection
questions.ex: Insulation traps air and reduces heat transfer through conduction and convection, keeping heat inside.

questions.q: Why is biodiversity important for ecosystems?
questions.ex: Greater biodiversity increases ecosystem resilience and stability, providing more functions and adaptability.

questions.q: How do roots and stems transport water and food in vascular plants?
questions.ex: Xylem transports water/minerals upward; phloem transports sugars throughout the plant.

questions.q: What happens to light when it passes from air into water?
options: It bends (refracts) due to change in speed
questions.ex: Light changes speed when entering a denser medium, causing it to bend (refraction).

questions.q: Why should we wash hands before eating?
options: To remove dirt and microbes and reduce disease risk
questions.ex: Washing hands removes dirt and harmful microbes, reducing the chance of infection and illness.

questions.q: Which body system carries oxygen and nutrients to cells?
questions.ex: The circulatory system (blood and vessels) distributes oxygen and nutrients to body cells.

questions.q: Which practice helps conserve soil and prevent erosion?
options: Planting cover crops and using terraces
questions.ex: Cover crops and terracing reduce runoff and protect soil from erosion.

questions.q: What is the main reason leaves have a large surface area?
options: To catch more sunlight for photosynthesis
questions.ex: A large surface area maximizes light capture for photosynthesis.

questions.q: Why is boiling water safer than drinking from an unknown stream?
options: Boiling kills many harmful microbes by high temperature
questions.ex: Boiling water kills bacteria, viruses, and parasites that cause waterborne diseases.

questions.q: How does a simple electric circuit stop when a switch is opened?
options: Circuit becomes incomplete so current stops
questions.ex: Opening the switch breaks the circuit, preventing current flow.

questions.q: Why do seasonal changes happen at different times in Pakistan and Australia?
options: Because hemispheres are tilted toward/away from the Sun at different times
questions.ex: Earth’s axial tilt causes opposite seasons in northern and southern hemispheres at the same time.

questions.q: How do pollinators increase fruit production in orchards?
options: By transferring pollen between flowers enabling fertilization
questions.ex: Pollinators transfer pollen from male to female parts of flowers, enabling fertilization and fruit set.

questions.q: Why are vaccines important for public health?
options: They train the immune system to recognize pathogens without causing illness
questions.ex: Vaccines expose the immune system to safe antigens, building immunity and preventing disease spread.

questions.q: A plant is shaded on one side; over time its stem curves toward the light. Which process explains this?
options: Phototropism due to auxin distribution causing cell elongation on the shaded side
questions.ex: Phototropism involves auxin relocating to shaded side, promoting cell elongation and bending toward light.

questions.q: Why does adding a catalyst lower activation energy in a chemical reaction?
options: It provides an alternative reaction pathway with lower activation energy
questions.ex: Catalysts provide an alternate mechanism that has a lower activation energy, increasing reaction rate without being consumed.

questions.q: If two resistors of equal resistance are connected in series to a battery, how does total current compare to a single resistor case?
questions.ex: Series resistors increase total resistance; for equal resistances, total doubles, so current halves (Ohm’s law).

questions.q: Why do deserts often have large temperature changes between day and night?
options: Lack of water vapor and vegetation reduces heat retention, so rapid cooling at night
Deserts are closer to the Sun
questions.ex: Low humidity and little vegetation reduce the atmosphere’s heat retention, causing large diurnal temperature variation.

questions.q: How does increasing the frequency of a wave affect its energy, assuming other factors constant?
options: Energy increases as energy is proportional to frequency for a photon
Frequency has no relation to energy
questions.ex: For waves like photons, energy is proportional to frequency (E = h·f); higher frequency means higher energy.

questions.q: Why does ice float on water?
options: Ice has trapped air making it heavier
Ice has lower density due to open crystal structure
questions.ex: Ice’s molecular structure is more open and less dense than liquid water, so it floats.

questions.q: Which human activity most directly increases atmospheric carbon dioxide on short time scales?
questions.ex: Burning fossil fuels releases CO2 rapidly by oxidizing stored carbon into the atmosphere.

questions.q: When a sound source moves toward an observer, the observer hears a higher pitch. What explains this?
options: Doppler effect: wavelength is compressed causing higher frequency perceived
Sound becomes louder but frequency unchanged
questions.ex: The Doppler effect causes wavelengths to compress when the source moves toward the observer, increasing perceived frequency (pitch).

questions.q: In an alternating current (AC) circuit, what does the RMS voltage represent?
options: Average of positive and negative peaks
Equivalent DC voltage delivering same power
questions.ex: RMS (root mean square) voltage is the effective DC-equivalent voltage that would deliver the same power to a resistive load.

questions.q: Why are decomposers essential in nutrient cycles?
options: They convert dead matter into inorganic nutrients available to producers
questions.ex: Decomposers break down organic matter, releasing nutrients like nitrogen and phosphorus back into the soil for plants.

questions.q: Which observation best supports that mitochondria produce ATP by using oxygen?
options: ATP increases in cells when oxygen is present and decreases when removed
ATP exists only in plant cells
Oxygen has no effect on ATP levels
ATP is produced only in nucleus
questions.ex: Aerobic respiration in mitochondria uses oxygen; ATP production drops when oxygen is limited.

questions.q: A plant’s xylem is blocked. What immediate effect would you expect?
options: Water and mineral transport to leaves is reduced causing wilting
questions.ex: Xylem transports water/minerals upward; blockage reduces supply to leaves, causing wilting.

questions.q: Which factor most affects the rate of diffusion of a gas through a membrane?
questions.ex: Diffusion rate depends strongly on the concentration gradient; larger gradients increase net diffusion rate.

questions.q: Why does metal feel colder than wood at the same temperature?
options: Metal conducts heat faster away from your skin, making it feel colder
questions.ex: Metal's higher thermal conductivity transfers heat away from skin more quickly, so it feels colder despite same temperature.

questions.q: Which adaptation helps desert plants reduce water loss?
options: Thick waxy cuticle and reduced leaf area
questions.ex: A thick waxy cuticle and reduced leaf surface area minimize transpiration, conserving water in deserts.

questions.q: How does sound travel through a vacuum?
options: It cannot travel because vacuum lacks a medium for mechanical waves
questions.ex: Sound is a mechanical wave requiring a material medium (air, water, solid); in vacuum there is no medium, so sound cannot travel.

questions.q: Which evidence would best show that two organisms share a recent common ancestor?
options: Similar DNA sequences and homologous structures
questions.ex: Similar DNA sequences and homologous anatomical structures indicate shared ancestry and evolutionary relationship.

questions.q: Why does a greenhouse become warmer than the outside air during the day?
options: Shortwave solar radiation enters and longwave heat is trapped, reducing convection loss
Plants inside create all the heat
questions.ex: Solar shortwave radiation passes glass and warms interior; re-emitted longwave infrared is partly trapped, causing warming.

questions.q: Which process most directly causes soil salinization in irrigated fields?
options: Evaporation of irrigation water leaving salts behind near surface
questions.ex: Evaporation concentrates dissolved salts at the soil surface in irrigated areas, leading to salinization.

questions.q: A parallel circuit has three identical bulbs; one burns out. What happens to the others?
options: Remaining bulbs stay lit at same brightness
questions.ex: In a parallel circuit each bulb has its own branch; if one burns out, others still receive full voltage and remain lit.

questions.q: Why does increasing pressure generally increase the boiling point of a liquid?
options: Pressure squeezes liquid molecules to solid
Higher external pressure requires higher temperature to form vapor bubbles inside the liquid
questions.ex: Higher external pressure makes it harder for vapor bubbles to form, so temperature must be higher to boil.

questions.q: Which property distinguishes living from non-living things?
options: Ability to reproduce, grow, and respond to environment through metabolism
questions.ex: Living organisms exhibit metabolism, growth, reproduction, and responsiveness, unlike non-living objects.

questions.q: How do vaccines produce herd immunity in a population?
options: By reducing the number of susceptible hosts so disease transmission falls below outbreak threshold
questions.ex: When many individuals are immune, chains of transmission are disrupted, protecting even those not immune.

questions.q: Why does warm air rise above cold air?
options: Warm air is less dense due to expansion and buoyant forces cause it to rise
questions.ex: Heating causes air to expand, lowering its density; buoyancy causes the warmer, lighter air to rise.

questions.q: Which adaptation is most likely in fish living in deep ocean with no light?
options: Bioluminescence and large sensitive eyes or no eyes with enhanced other senses
questions.ex: Deep-sea species often evolve bioluminescence and enhanced sensory structures or reduced eyes adapted to darkness.

questions.q: During digestion, which organ produces enzymes and releases them into the small intestine to help digest fats, proteins, and carbohydrates?
questions.ex: The pancreas produces digestive enzymes (lipase, proteases, amylase) and secretes them into the small intestine.

questions.q: Why are fossil fuels considered non-renewable on human timescales?
options: They form over millions of years from buried organic matter, much slower than current use
They are produced by plants every year
questions.ex: Fossil fuels require geological time to form, so current consumption outpaces natural replenishment making them non-renewable.

questions.q: If a star appears red compared to another star that appears blue, what does this tell us about their surface temperatures?
options: Red star is hotter than blue star
Red star is cooler than blue star
questions.ex: Star color corresponds to temperature: blue stars are hotter, red stars are cooler (blackbody radiation).

questions.q: Why does increased greenhouse gas concentration raise Earth’s average temperature?
options: They reflect sunlight back to space
They trap outgoing infrared radiation, reducing heat loss and warming the atmosphere
They cool the atmosphere by making clouds
questions.ex: Greenhouse gases absorb and re-radiate infrared emitted by Earth, reducing heat loss to space and warming the planet.

questions.q: A solution conducts electricity; which statement is most likely true?
options: It contains ions from dissolved salts or acids/bases that allow current flow
questions.ex: Electrical conduction in liquids is due to mobile ions from dissolved electrolytes, not pure water.

questions.q: What is the capital city of Pakistan?
questions.ex: Islamabad is the federal capital city of Pakistan since the 1960s.

questions.q: Which river is the longest in Pakistan?
questions.ex: The Indus River is the longest river in Pakistan, flowing from the Himalayas to the Arabian Sea.

questions.q: Who is known as the 'Father of the Nation' in Pakistan?
questions.ex: Muhammad Ali Jinnah, the founder of Pakistan, is commonly referred to as Quaid-e-Azam and Father of the Nation.

questions.q: Which sea borders Pakistan to the south?
questions.ex: Pakistan's southern coast lies along the Arabian Sea.

questions.q: What is the national language of Pakistan?
questions.ex: Urdu is the national language of Pakistan; English is an official language but not the national language.

questions.q: Which of the following is a national symbol of Pakistan?
questions.ex: The markhor is the national animal of Pakistan.

questions.q: In which province is Karachi located?
questions.ex: Karachi is the capital of Sindh province.

questions.q: Which document is the supreme law of Pakistan?
questions.ex: The Constitution of Pakistan is the supreme law governing the country.

questions.q: Which currency is used in Pakistan?
questions.ex: The Pakistani rupee (PKR) is the currency of Pakistan.

questions.q: What color is primarily used on the national flag of Pakistan?
questions.ex: The Pakistani flag has a dark green field with a white crescent and star.

questions.q: Which mountain range lies in northern Pakistan?
questions.ex: Northern Pakistan includes parts of the Himalayas as well as the Karakoram.

questions.q: Which port city is Pakistan's largest by population and economic activity?
questions.ex: Karachi is Pakistan's largest city and main economic hub with major ports.

questions.q: Who was the first Prime Minister of Pakistan?
questions.ex: Liaquat Ali Khan served as Pakistan's first Prime Minister after independence.

questions.q: What is the official religion of Pakistan as stated in the Constitution?
questions.ex: Islam is the state religion of Pakistan according to the Constitution.

questions.q: Which region is known as the 'breadbasket' of Pakistan due to fertile plains?
questions.ex: The Punjab plains are the main agricultural region producing staples like wheat and rice.

questions.q: What is the national language script used for Urdu?
questions.ex: Urdu is written in a Perso-Arabic script commonly displayed in the Nastaliq style.

questions.q: Which sea port is located in southwestern Balochistan developed under CPEC?
questions.ex: Gwadar Port in Balochistan has been developed as part of CPEC and regional development initiatives.

questions.q: Which Pakistani leader delivered the famous Allahabad Address that inspired the idea of a separate Muslim state?
questions.ex: Allama Muhammad Iqbal's 1930 Allahabad Address articulated the concept of a separate homeland for Muslims in northwest India.

questions.q: Which crop is the staple food crop in Pakistan?
questions.ex: Wheat is the major staple cereal consumed across Pakistan.

questions.q: What symbol appears alongside the crescent on the Pakistani flag?
questions.ex: The flag shows a white crescent and a five-pointed white star.

questions.q: Which city is the provincial capital of Sindh?
questions.ex: Karachi is both the largest city and the capital of Sindh province.

questions.q: Which national monument commemorates Pakistan's independence movement and is located in Karachi?
questions.ex: Mazar-e-Quaid is the mausoleum of Muhammad Ali Jinnah in Karachi.

questions.q: Which of the following is a major export crop of Pakistan?
questions.ex: Cotton is a key cash crop and major export from Pakistan's agriculture sector.

questions.q: What is the minimum voting age in Pakistan for general elections?
questions.ex: The legal voting age for national and provincial elections in Pakistan is 18.

questions.q: Which desert is located in southern Pakistan and Sindh?
questions.ex: The Thar Desert extends across southeastern Sindh and into India.

questions.q: Which monument in Lahore marks the site where the Pakistan Resolution was passed (1940)?
questions.ex: Minar-e-Pakistan was built at the site where the 1940 Lahore (Pakistan) Resolution was adopted.

questions.q: What is Pakistan's official name as per the Constitution?
questions.ex: The Constitution names the country the Islamic Republic of Pakistan.

questions.q: Which body elects the President of Pakistan?
questions.ex: The President is elected by an Electoral College comprising both houses of Parliament and members of provincial assemblies.

questions.q: Which province of Pakistan has Karachi as its capital and is known for its sea coast?
questions.ex: Sindh province has Karachi as its capital and a long coastline on the Arabian Sea.

questions.q: Which language is widely spoken in Sindh besides Urdu?
questions.ex: Sindhi is the major regional language of Sindh province.

questions.q: Which two provinces does the Indus River primarily flow through in Pakistan?
questions.ex: The Indus flows through Punjab (its fertile plains) and then through Sindh to the Arabian Sea.

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the National Assembly in Pakistan?
options: To make federal laws and represent the people
questions.ex: The National Assembly is the lower house of Parliament responsible for legislation and representing citizens at the federal level.

questions.q: Which era is associated with the Indus Valley Civilization (Harappa and Mohenjo-daro)?
questions.ex: The Indus Valley Civilization (including Harappa and Mohenjo-daro) dates to the Bronze Age (c. 3300–1300 BCE).

questions.q: Which economic sector employs the largest share of Pakistan's rural population?
questions.ex: Agriculture is the dominant employer in rural Pakistan, providing livelihoods for a majority.

questions.q: What role does the Senate play in Pakistan's federal legislature?
options: Represents the federation and reviews legislation
questions.ex: The Senate represents provinces, reviews and approves legislation, and provides balance to the National Assembly.

questions.q: Which city in Sindh was the capital of the Talpur and later the British district, known for its historic gates?
questions.ex: Hyderabad served historically as an important administrative and cultural center with remaining city gates.

questions.q: Which constitutional amendment in Pakistan introduced the procedure for electing the Prime Minister by the National Assembly and reduced the President's power to dismiss the government (commonly known for limiting presidential powers)?
questions.ex: The 18th Amendment (2010) restored parliamentary powers and curtailed presidential authority to dissolve assemblies.

questions.q: What is the importance of the Sufi shrines in Sindh's cultural life?
options: They are centers of folk music, spirituality and local festivals
They are centers of industrial production
questions.ex: Sufi shrines in Sindh are cultural and spiritual centers that host qawwali, urs celebrations and community gatherings.

questions.q: Which mineral resource is Sindh particularly known for producing?
questions.ex: Sindh has significant deposits of coal (e.g., Lakhra) and natural gas fields contributing to energy supply.

questions.q: Which constitutional body supervises elections at national and provincial levels in Pakistan?
questions.ex: The Election Commission of Pakistan is constitutionally responsible for conducting and supervising elections.

questions.q: What is the primary reason for the fertile soils of the Indus plain?
options: Annual riverine silt deposition from Indus and its tributaries
questions.ex: Sediment deposited by the Indus and tributaries during floods created highly fertile alluvial soils in the plains.

questions.q: Which Mughal-era site in Sindh is recognized for its architecture and is near Hyderabad?
questions.ex: The Chaukhandi Tombs, near Karachi and Sindh region, are notable for ornate sandstone tombs of the medieval period.

questions.q: Which economic challenge is commonly faced by Pakistan that affects education and health spending?
options: Budgetary constraints and limited public revenue
questions.ex: Pakistan faces budget constraints and limited revenues, affecting allocations for social sectors.

questions.q: What was the primary objective of the Pakistan Movement led by the All-India Muslim League?
options: To establish a secular state in India
To create a homeland for Muslims where they could exercise political rights
To merge all princely states into India
questions.ex: The Pakistan Movement sought a separate Muslim-majority homeland for political and social rights of Muslims.

questions.q: Which city in Sindh was a major center of the ancient Indus Valley Civilization?
questions.ex: Mohenjo-daro, located in Sindh near the Indus, is a principal site of the ancient Indus Valley Civilization.

questions.q: How does federalism in Pakistan aim to balance power between the center and provinces?
options: By centralizing all powers in Islamabad
By assigning certain subjects to the federal government and others to provinces
By allowing provinces to secede at will
By letting provinces impose their own national currency
questions.ex: Pakistan's federal system divides powers through federal and provincial legislative lists and shared subjects.

questions.q: Which Sindhi poet and Sufi saint is famous for his verses and influence in Sindh's culture?
questions.ex: Shah Abdul Latif Bhittai is a revered Sindhi Sufi poet whose poetry and songs are central to Sindh's cultural heritage.

questions.q: Which infrastructure project improved irrigation and agricultural productivity in Pakistan's Indus basin?
options: Indus Basin Irrigation System (including canals and barrages)
questions.ex: The Indus Basin irrigation works — canals, barrages and dams — are key to Pakistan's agriculture.

questions.q: What is the function of a caretaker government during election periods in Pakistan?
options: To manage day-to-day affairs impartially until a new elected government takes office
questions.ex: A caretaker government is expected to run routine state affairs neutrally during the election period.

questions.q: Which architectural site in Sindh is famous for its unique large defensive wall and is sometimes called the 'Great Wall of Sindh'?
questions.ex: Ranikot Fort, near Sann in Sindh, has an extensive circumference and is often called the 'Great Wall of Sindh.'

questions.q: Which feature best describes Karachi's climate compared to northern Pakistan?
options: Tropical wet with monsoon rains and milder winters
questions.ex: Karachi has a coastal climate with relatively mild winters and summer monsoon influences.

questions.q: Which right is typically guaranteed by Pakistan's Constitution to its citizens?
options: Right to free education at all levels unconditionally
Right to freedom of speech subject to reasonable restrictions
Right to hold dual citizenship without restriction
questions.ex: The Constitution provides freedom of speech but allows reasonable restrictions in the interests of security, morality and public order.

questions.q: What is the main reason the port of Karachi is important to Pakistan's economy?
options: It is the only port in Pakistan
It handles a large share of the country’s international trade and shipping
It produces most of Pakistan’s agricultural goods
It is a major mining center
questions.ex: Karachi's ports handle much of Pakistan's imports and exports, making them vital to trade.

questions.q: Which festival is widely celebrated in Sindh linked to Sufi traditions?
options: The urs (death anniversary) of Sufi saints
questions.ex: Urs commemorations at Sufi shrines are important cultural festivals in Sindh.

questions.q: Which historic movement used non-violent civil disobedience and influenced Pakistan's freedom struggle indirectly through ideas about self-determination?
options: Indian National Congress campaigns and Gandhian non-violence
questions.ex: The wider Indian independence movement, including Gandhian non-violent tactics, shaped political discourse; Muslim League pursued separate political aims.

questions.q: Which body can declare a state of emergency in Pakistan?
options: President on advice of the Prime Minister and cabinet or under specific constitutional provisions
questions.ex: The President may proclaim emergency under constitutional procedures, usually on federal advice and subject to judicial review.

questions.q: Which water project links reservoirs to provide storage and irrigation in Sindh and Punjab?
options: Tarbela Dam as part of Indus Basin Projects
questions.ex: Tarbela (and other dams) are key components of the Indus Basin Projects managing storage, power and irrigation.

questions.q: Which practice helps conserve water in Pakistan's agriculture?
options: Use of canal water with modern techniques like drip and better scheduling
questions.ex: Modern irrigation techniques, efficient canal management and crop choices improve water use in agriculture.

questions.q: Which prominent Sindhi city served as a medieval port and capital of Sindh under various dynasties and is known for its Makli Hills necropolis nearby?
questions.ex: Thatta was a historic capital and is near the Makli Hills, a large necropolis of Islamic funerary architecture.

questions.q: Which constitutional principle ensures that no law shall contravene the basic rights guaranteed to citizens?
options: Supremacy of the Constitution and judicial review
questions.ex: The Constitution is supreme and courts can review laws for consistency with fundamental rights.

questions.q: Why is the Indus River system particularly important for Pakistan's economy beyond irrigation?
options: It provides most of the country's mineral deposits
It supports hydropower generation, transportation, fisheries and groundwater recharge
It allows direct sea navigation to international ports
It is the only source of rainfall
questions.ex: The Indus supports hydropower, fisheries, transport in some stretches and recharges aquifers, contributing broadly to the economy.

questions.q: Which constitutional article or concept limits the dissolution of provincial assemblies by the federal government, aiming to preserve provincial autonomy?
options: Article related to federal legislative list
Article concerning the distribution of residuary powers
Principles introduced by 18th Amendment strengthening provincial autonomy and checks on federal power
Article allowing direct presidential rule without constraints
questions.ex: The 18th Amendment restored provincial autonomy and established checks limiting arbitrary federal intervention in assemblies.

questions.q: How did the Green Revolution affect Sindh and Punjab differently in mid-20th century Pakistan?
options: It equally transformed both provinces with identical crops and irrigation patterns
Punjab benefited more due to larger canal infrastructure and land holdings, while Sindh saw gains but with greater regional variation
Sindh benefited exclusively while Punjab remained unchanged
questions.ex: Punjab's extensive irrigation and larger farms allowed quicker adoption of Green Revolution technologies; Sindh experienced gains but unevenly.

questions.q: Which feature distinguishes Mohenjo-daro from many later South Asian urban sites?
options: A planned grid layout with advanced drainage and standardized bricks
questions.ex: Mohenjo-daro shows urban planning, grid streets, sewage systems and uniform brick sizes uncommon in many later sites.

questions.q: Which governance challenge is created by water-sharing between provinces in Pakistan and what constitutional mechanism addresses it?
options: No challenge exists; provinces have complete water control
Inter-provincial water disputes are resolved through the Indus River System Authority (IRSA) and federal laws with constitutional backing
Only international bodies govern water inside Pakistan
Local districts resolve all water conflicts without provincial role
questions.ex: IRSA and related frameworks coordinate water allocation among provinces, backed by federal legislation to manage disputes.

questions.q: Why is the preservation of the Mangrove forests in Sindh's delta ecologically significant?
options: They act as nursery grounds for fisheries, protect coasts from erosion and store carbon
They provide large urban housing areas
They are the primary source of freshwater
questions.ex: Mangroves support fish populations, buffer storm surges, prevent erosion and sequester carbon, important for coastal ecology.

questions.q: Which factor most contributed to the decline of Harappan urban centers like Mohenjo-daro according to mainstream archaeological interpretations?
options: Complex causes including river course changes, environmental shifts, and socio-economic transformations rather than a single cause
questions.ex: Scholars point to a combination of shifting river channels, climatic changes, and societal adjustments as likely reasons for decline.

questions.q: How does the 1973 Constitution of Pakistan structure the relationship between Islam and state law?
options: It declares no role for Islam
It declares Pakistan an Islamic Republic and requires laws to be consistent with Islamic injunctions, with institutions like the Council of Islamic Ideology to advise
It establishes a secular state with no religious advisory bodies
It places religious law above the Constitution
questions.ex: The 1973 Constitution defines Pakistan as Islamic Republic and mandates that laws align with Islamic principles, with advisory bodies to recommend interpretations.

questions.q: Which economic rationale supports development of Gwadar in Balochistan and its significance for Sindh and national trade?
options: Gwadar is only symbolic with no strategic value
It provides a deep-sea port reducing dependence on Karachi, can shorten trade routes for western China and diversify national port capacity, impacting regional trade dynamics including Sindh
It will replace all Sindh ports immediately
It is intended solely for fishing
questions.ex: Gwadar's deep-water capacity and location on trade routes aim to diversify Pakistan's port infrastructure and facilitate regional trade, complementing Sindh ports.

questions.q: Why are urban governance issues in Karachi particularly complex compared to other Pakistani cities?
options: Because Karachi has a homogeneous population
Due to its extreme population diversity, migration patterns, fragmented administrative jurisdictions and economic centrality
Because it has no ports or industries
Because it is in the northern mountains
questions.ex: Karachi's large, diverse population, migration, overlapping municipal, provincial and federal responsibilities and major economic role create governance complexity.

questions.q: Which constitutional safeguard aims to protect minority rights in Pakistan?
options: No mention of minorities in the Constitution
Articles guaranteeing freedom of religion and equality before the law, with protections against discrimination
A clause requiring minorities to follow state religion
A provision that minorities cannot hold public office
questions.ex: The Constitution includes provisions for freedom of religion and equality, and laws exist to protect minority rights, though implementation varies.

questions.q: From a historical perspective, what was a major administrative innovation of the Mughal state that influenced later Sindh governance?
options: A centralized revenue administration with land assessment practices and provincial subahs that influenced administrative patterns
Exclusive use of maritime trade taxes
questions.ex: Mughal revenue systems, land assessment and provincial administration informed later governance and revenue practices in the region.

questions.q: Which strategy would best help reduce flood risk in Sindh's low-lying areas while preserving livelihoods?
options: Integrated measures: improved early warning, embankment management, wetland restoration, and livelihood diversification
questions.ex: A combined approach balancing infrastructure, ecosystem restoration and alternative livelihoods offers sustainable flood risk reduction.

questions.q: How did partition in 1947 affect Sindh's demographic and urban character?
options: Large migrations occurred: Muslim refugees arrived from India, many Hindus migrated out, changing urban demographics and accelerating growth in cities like Karachi
questions.ex: Partition brought significant population shifts, with migrants reshaping Sindh's urban population, economy and social composition.

questions.q: Which policy measure can improve agricultural water productivity in Pakistan within limited land and water resources?
options: Shifting to high-value crops where appropriate, improving irrigation efficiency and crop diversification
questions.ex: Enhancing irrigation efficiency, selecting suitable crops and diversifying farming practices raise productivity under constrained water supplies.

questions.q: Which institution in Pakistan has primary responsibility for safeguarding the Constitution and interpreting laws?
questions.ex: The Supreme Court is the highest judicial body charged with constitutional interpretation and protecting the Constitution.

questions.q: Why is archaeological conservation at Mohenjo-daro challenging?
options: The site is modern and needs no conservation
Due to environmental threats (salt, erosion), limited funding, tourism pressures and need for specialized conservation techniques
Because there is no interest in history
questions.ex: Conservation faces salt weathering, erosion, scarce resources and the need for ongoing scientific preservation measures.

questions.q: Which economic indicator best reflects Sindh's contribution to Pakistan's national GDP?
options: Sindh contributes significantly through industrial output, services (especially Karachi) and agriculture, making it one of the top contributors
Sindh's economy is solely agricultural with no industry
questions.ex: Sindh, with Karachi as an industrial and financial center plus agricultural zones, is a major contributor to national GDP.

questions.q: How can civic education strengthen democratic participation among Pakistani primary students?
options: By avoiding any mention of civic duties
By teaching basic rights and responsibilities, critical thinking, respect for diversity and practical participation such as school councils
By focusing only on rote memorization of leaders' names
By discouraging discussion of public issues
questions.ex: Civic education that includes rights, responsibilities and engagement skills fosters informed democratic participation from a young age.

questions.q: Which approach best addresses urban flooding in Karachi due to intense monsoon rainfall?
options: Rely solely on pumps without planning
Improve drainage planning, enforce building on floodplains, maintain stormwater channels and restore wetlands
Allow uncontrolled construction on natural drains
questions.ex: Comprehensive drainage management, regulation and ecosystem restoration reduce urban flooding risks effectively.

questions.q: Which factor complicates accurate census and representation in Pakistan's provinces including Sindh?
options: Rapid urbanization, internal migration, and undercounting in some areas affecting resource allocation and political representation
questions.ex: Dynamic migration patterns and urban growth make accurate census-taking challenging, impacting allocation and representation.

questions.q: Which historical factor led to Sindh's early integration into global trade networks in medieval times?
options: Its coastal ports like Thatta and Karachi and access to Arabian Sea trade routes linked Sindh to Indian Ocean commerce
questions.ex: Sindh's ports and coastal position connected it historically to Arabian Sea trade, facilitating cultural and economic links.

questions.q: How do national symbols like the flag and anthem contribute to citizenship education in Pakistan?
options: They are purely decorative with no educational value
They help build a sense of shared identity and civic pride while teaching respect for national institutions
They prevent any discussion of history
They are unrelated to concepts of citizenship
questions.ex: National symbols serve as tools in citizenship education to foster unity, identity and respect for civic values.

questions.q: Which long-term measure can help reduce energy shortages affecting Sindh's industries and households?
options: Relying only on imported oil indefinitely
Diversifying energy mix with renewables, improving grid efficiency and developing local gas and hydropower resources
questions.ex: A diversified energy strategy, efficiency improvements and local resource development support more stable supply.

questions.q: What distinguishes Pakistan's federal parliamentary system from a presidential system in practice?
options: The Prime Minister is head of government and accountable to the legislature, while the President is largely ceremonial (subject to constitutional powers), unlike a presidential system where the president is both head of state and government
The President controls daily governance exclusively
There is no legislature in Pakistan
questions.ex: In Pakistan's parliamentary system the PM leads the government and is responsible to Parliament; the President has limited, mostly ceremonial roles.

questions.q: Which element of Sindh's heritage reflects multi-religious past and attracts researchers studying syncretism?
options: Sufi shrines, ancient Buddhist and Hindu archaeological sites and shared folk traditions showing religious syncretism
questions.ex: Sindh's Sufi traditions alongside archaeological remains from Buddhist and Hindu periods show cultural and religious overlaps studied for syncretism.

questions.q: Which policy helps manage rural poverty in Sindh while promoting sustainable development?
options: Cutting all agricultural support and subsidies
Combining social safety nets, rural infrastructure, access to credit and agricultural extension services
Forcing all farmers to move to cities
questions.ex: Integrated policies—social protection, infrastructure, credit access and extension—support poverty reduction and sustainable rural growth.

questions.q: Which legal mechanism allows citizens in Pakistan to seek protection of their fundamental rights?
options: Filing a writ petition (e.g., habeas corpus, mandamus) in the superior courts including the High Courts and Supreme Court
questions.ex: Citizens can file constitutional writs in High Courts or the Supreme Court to enforce fundamental rights guaranteed by the Constitution.

questions.q: Which factor most influences Sindh's internal regional disparities between urban centers like Karachi and rural districts?
options: Uneven economic investment, industrial concentration in urban hubs, governance capacity and infrastructure differences
The presence of identical industries everywhere
Lack of any agricultural activity in rural Sindh
questions.ex: Economic concentration in cities, differential investment, infrastructure and governance create regional disparities within Sindh.

questions.q: How can teachers incorporate local heritage like Mohenjo-daro or Sufi poetry into primary Social Studies to strengthen students' civic identity?
options: By providing factual stories, field trips, creative projects and linking local heritage to broader national identity and values
By avoiding local topics and focusing only on foreign history
By requiring memorization of random dates only
By discouraging student engagement with local culture
questions.ex: Engaging methods—stories, visits, projects—connect students to local heritage and civic identity in meaningful ways.
